title: Quality control description
description: Model for description of quality controls used in a statistical production.

quality_control_name.description: Stable name used with recorded_at to discover history. Renaming starts a different named series.

event_id.description: Stable identifier of this definition record; quality_control_id remains the definition reference.

recorded_at.description: Timezone-aware instant when this reusable definition was recorded.

gsbpm_code.description: Optional GSBPM code from Klass classification 933; measures refer to this definition's selection.

producer_metadata.description: Team-defined JSON-compatible quality-definition details; cannot override named fields.

quality_control_type.description: Quality control type: hard (H), soft (S), informative (I).

variables.description: A description of which variables must be included in the quality control.
